name: FamiliesTips
description: Clan Primer Traveler's Tips: four ungated 'Weapon Families' tips carrying the per-family identity text (0.1.35 wording: counter augment, bomb status) (moved off weapon help; that runtime feature is reverted separately). Extends the deployed 17-entry state: the 16 native tips plus the Proficiency tip. Titles go into penelosdiary rows 654-657 (IDs 0x16E0-0x16E3), found empty and unreferenced the same way row 661 was. Flag 255 writes check byte 2 = 0xFF, the format's own no-flag-test convention, so the game shows these tips unconditionally.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Heavy
tips.body:
Each family fights in its own way. No license needed.
Greatsword Sweep: attacking a foe cleaves a half circle
around it for half damage, but the swing is slow.
Axe Sunder: each hit dents the foe's Defense by five
percent of its starting value, down to half, for the
rest of the fight.
Axe Reckless: each swing dents your own Defense by five
percent, down to a quarter off.
Hammer Concussion: Disable 15 percent on hit, a 30
percent knockback chance. The swing is slow.
Spear Pierce: every hit ignores 30 percent of the
foe's Defense. A spear never parries, except to
counter, and a counter needs the Counter augment.
It still blocks and dodges.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Light
tips.body:
Each family fights in its own way. No license needed.
Sword Guard: the best weapon evade, 20 to 40, but a
parry or block pushes your next charge back 10 percent.
Katana Chain: combos run one hit longer, yet after a
combo the next attack on you meets no evasion.
Ninja sword Unseen: hits cannot be parried or blocked,
though the dodge still applies. Every blade carries
Blind 10 percent on hit, and some add a second status.
Dagger Swift: the fastest charge, frequent combos, a
little evade on the blade.
Glancing: against heavy armor, dagger and ninja sword
hits fall to an eighth of the attack, not a quarter.
Fists Cadence: Attacks on one foe in a row hit 6
percent harder each, up to 30 percent, and quicken
your next action. A full streak counts as a counter
for Ki Flow. Switching foes restarts the ramp.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Ranged
tips.body:
Each family fights in its own way. No license needed.
Bow Volley: the keenest critical chance among the
ranged weapons.
Crossbow Afflict: the bolt's status chance is doubled,
up to 100 percent. Bolts take a little longer to load.
Gun True aim: a gunner's shots never miss, Blind or
not, and ignore Defense. Damage depends on the gun
alone, and the gun charges slowly.
Hand-bomb Barrage: the bombs you load decide the
status, 25 percent on hit, and some carry none.
Chaos Bombs, which Confuse, and Stun Bombs, which
Stop, set up a Time Mage's Detonate.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Magick
tips.body:
Each family fights in its own way. No license needed.
Rod Mend: healing spells heal 20 percent more while
held. Potions are unchanged. A heal that overflows
draws Lure to the caster.
Staff Channel: element potency, and the most Magick of
the caster weapons.
Mace Spellbreak: hits burn MP equal to 10 percent of
the damage, at most 10 percent of the foe's pool.
Measure Tempo: each measure grants one status to an
ally it strikes: Protect, Shell, Bravery, Invisible,
Haste or Bubble, by tier.
Pole Counterflow: counters even without the Counter
augment, found on the Battle Harness or Magepower
Shishak, twice as often with it. Blows taken build
the next counter, and the pole strikes Magick Resist.
Its evade is 25 to 30, so its counters can swing.
